Production checkBuild already deletes prior evidence before builders, executes the real child processes, and invokes committedSource before publishing evidence. Repeating outer authorization and both CI plans adds no distinct protection for those later build-only steps.

The first integration case likewise unnecessarily repeated the full route for missing evidence and same-HEAD artifact reuse; it remained close to the timeout in matrix2. This repair evaluates every preflight call in the entire module instead of only the latest failed assertion.
Prior targeted timings did not reproduce full-matrix wall time. No CPU/I/O profile establishes the exact load contribution, and a timed passing retry alone is not the corrective evidence.
